title: Morning Brief — Friday, 27 November 2026
description: Australia's national bulk-billing rate climbs to a new high, Queensland sends its largest-ever trade delegation to Shanghai's China International Import Expo, and the Gold Coast opens tenders for a new light rail extension linking the university hospital to Harbour Town. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
